pins.title: Should you blind buy perfume? The $150 rule for niche fragrance
pins.description: Should you blind buy perfume? For niche fragrance, rarely. Blind buy only if the bottle is under about $150, you already love a similar scent, none of the notes are your known enemies, and the shop takes returns. Above $150, sample first: a 2 ml sample typically costs around $13. Affiliate links on the page. #ad #blindbuy
pins.alt: Typographic card on cream titled 'Should you blind buy a niche perfume? Rarely.' It lists the $150 rule: blind buy only if the bottle is under about $150, you already love a scent wearers compare it to, none of the notes are your known enemies, and the shop takes returns. Above $150, sample first.

image.headline: Rarely.
image.sub: Blind buy a niche bottle only if all four are true:
steps: You already love a scent wearers compare it to.
None of the notes are your known enemies.
The shop takes returns, or you'd happily gift it.
image.line: Above $150, sample first. Every time. Even if TikTok is screaming.
